claims: C1 the AI assistant is fundamentally a tool designed to empower users and developers
C2 to the extent it is safe and feasible, OpenAI aims to maximize users' autonomy and ability to use and customize the tool according to their needs

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: user_or_developer
concepts.gloss: a person who uses the assistant or develops with it

concepts.name: tool
concepts.gloss: the assistant considered as a tool designed to empower users and developers

concepts.name: assistant_is_tool
concepts.gloss: the assistant A is the tool T that users and developers interact with

concepts.name: safe_and_feasible
concepts.gloss: using and customizing tool T for user U is safe and feasible in the situation

asserts.read_back: OpenAI aims to maximize %'s autonomy and ability to use and customize % to the extent it is safe and feasible
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), user_or_developer(U), tool(T), assistant_is_tool(A, T), safe_and_feasible(T, U)

closure.reason: the clause states an aim to maximize use and customization, not a prohibition; silence about other acts leaves them permitted
